title: Abhisanda (or Sayhaka)
text: 2. Cattāro me bhi- puññabhisandā- katame cattāro || || 3. Idha bhikkhave ariyasāvako Buddhe- -Dhamme || pe [pa] || {Saṅghe} || || Paññavā hoti udayatthagāminiyā paññāya samannāgato ariyāya nibbedhikāya sammādukkhakkhaya gāminiyā [page 402] 402 Sotāpatti-Saṃyuttam LV. [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] || ayaṃ catuttho puññābhisando kusalābhisando sukhassāhāro || || Ime kho bhikkhave cattāro- -sukhassāhārā || || 4. Imehi kho bhikkhave- -na sukaraṃ gaṇetuṃ- -mahapuññakkhandho teva saṅkhaṃ gacchatī ti || || 5. Idam avoca Bhagavā || || Yo puññakāmo kusale patiṭṭhito || bhāveti maggam amatassa pattiyā || so dhammasārādhigamo khaye rato || na vedhati maccurāja gamissatī ti || ||
